notes.title: Stopping Linux Support :(
notes.content:
I have very bad news...

I stop supporting the Zomcats Invasion Linux Version thanks to some unknown graphics bug that happens in the Linux Build, making the game unplayable for some on Linux.

I cannot reproduce it and it does not give me any errors.
There is no way for me to fix this issue...

I am very sorry :(
-Tinky

notes.title: Version 0.58
notes.content:
[h1]Another BIG Update![/h1]

[i]NEW:[/i]
-Clicking on items will now open a small window that gives options for the item and shows the items description.

-Added 1 new case which can be opened for a chance to receive a [i]normal[/i]/[i]shop[/i]/[i]animated[/i] item. [i](Animated Items are rare)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/c177b884ed9ecd5d994b50426dc30d00bee9c06e.png[/img]

-Added animated item support. (You can now upload animated cosmetics on the workshop!)

-New map [b]Infinite Rooms[/b] WIP
Everytime you buy a room, a new room will appear and the room will be randomized.
[i](Can be very buggy for now, please report bugs!)[/i]

-Added 2 new cosmetics for first time downloaders. ([i]Orange Headband[/i], [i]Green Headband[/i])

-Sprite Sorting now added, so stuff actually appears infront of you.

-New Icons for special item types like: "Normal Items", "Shop Items", "Animated Shop Items" and "Animated Items"

-Added footsteps sound and some environment sounds.

-Added the ability to see other players class in the lobby.

-Improved Prison buyable walls costs.

-After buying items you will get a notification

-Added a new "unboxing" window for found/bought/unboxed items with cool sounds! (Thanks to [i]Flowy Flow[/i])

-Added a new "supporter DLC"
-Added 10 new colors for DLC owners
-Added 1 new DLC item "Supporter Visor"


[i]Fixes:[/i]
-Main Menu Inventory optimization.
-Blurry Sprites.
-Shadows on the Prison map did not appear.
-Zomcats getting stuck because of collisions.
-Idling to receive items
-Bandana looking bad
[i]I fixed alot more but I am too stupid to remember <3[/i]


[b]Have fun with the new update everyone <3[/b]
[i]-Tinky[/i]
